purpose: Define how official DOJ press releases can be used as source carriers in the DOJ SLS pilot.
core_rule: An official press release is a source event. It may signal a motion, termination, dismissal, completion, or policy posture. It is not itself a court docket, a consent decree, a misconduct finding, a person record, or a complete history.
blocked_uses: current legal status assertion without docket/order accession
department misconduct finding without underlying findings document and claim gate
source_bias_warning: A press release is official but rhetorically framed by the issuing administration and office. Treat it as a source carrier, not as a neutral adjudicator.
